method: Ran fifteen offline assertions. The verifier checks leakage, compiles and executes the example through 240 fake request slots, injects boolean and malformed cache usage, refusal/truncation/empty/invalid output and timeout cases, confirms every attempted request is archived, tests archive no-overwrite and checks that console output omits prompt and response text. No provider call was made. The production build, search index, and full-page light/dark renders were verified.
limitations: The 2026-10-08 result tables have no archived per-call prompts/responses, model snapshot, task-run mapping or scorer; they were not reproduced.
The old one-pass 10-item comparison and small format/wrong-label summaries cannot establish generalization, causal effects, format sensitivity, or a universal optimal example count.
The fake SDK verifies local request construction and scoring boundaries only; it does not establish current Anthropic SDK/API/model quality, latency, costs, or semantic label validity.
The current sample sentiment rubric is illustrative; a real task needs an independently reviewed label policy and representative held-out set.
The current Anthropic SDK and provider endpoint were not run; live model quality, latency and billing remain unverified.
Initial visual navigation reports the existing favicon.ico 404; the page itself has no horizontal overflow. Live provider behavior remains unverified.
